# 初始化大小，最小，最大
datasource.default.initialSize=5
datasource.default.minIdle=5
datasource.default.maxActive=10
# 配置获取连接等待超时的时间
datasource.default.maxWait=60000
# 配置间隔多久才进行一次检测，检测需要关闭的空闲连接，单位是毫秒
datasource.default.timeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis=60000
# 配置一个连接在池中最小生存的时间，单位是毫秒
datasource.default.minEvictableIdleTimeMillis=300000
datasource.default.validationQuery=SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
datasource.default.testWhileIdle=true
datasource.default.testOnBorrow=false
datasource.default.testOnReturn=false
# 打开PSCache，并且指定每个连接上PSCache的大小
datasource.default.poolPreparedStatements=true
datasource.default.maxPoolPreparedStatementPerConnectionSize=20
# 配置监控统计拦截的filters，去掉后监控界面sql无法统计，'wall'用于防火墙
#datasource.default.filters=stat,wall,log4j
datasource.default.logSlowSql=true
# 通过connectProperties属性来打开mergeSql功能；慢SQL记录
datasource.default.connectionProperties=druid.stat.mergeSql=true;druid.stat.slowSqlMillis=5000

# ========================================================================

# 登录控制台的用户名和密码, 敏感信息，注意保密 @Symon

# ShardingDb config 20230116 add for sharding @Symon

# init entity config list @Symon
spring.app.supported.entity.list=MXCC99990900,MXCC20220000,MXDC20220000
# 日志脱敏, log sensitive, 配置了后将会以**的格式进行打印 @Symon
logging.sensitive=trueName:last_four;cvv;pin;firstName;middleName;lastName;lastName2,phoneNo:pan;email;idValue;x-api-key;X-Api-Key
# sharding secrets aws.secrets.manager @Symon
aws.secrets.manager.region=us-east-1
aws.secrets.remote.name=CoreBankingFundcoreSecretProd
# stardatasource list
spring.stardatasource.names=corebankingShadow,corebankingA1,corebankingB1
# ========================================================================
# ======== Module:datasource common config end ========
# ========================================================================


# ========================================================================
# ======== Module:datasource corebankingA1 config start ========
# ========================================================================
# stori db, 数据库的连接地址、用户名和密码，敏感信息，请勿泄露 @Symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.name=corebankingA1
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.asyncInit=true
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.dataSourceClassName=com.alibaba.druid.pool.DruidDataSource
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.driverClassName=com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.url=jdbc:mysql://core-banking-middleware-r1.cluster-cutyhv5lxbqp.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com:3306/urule?useUnicode=true&characterEncoding=UTF-8
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.username=urule-2025
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.password=@PASSWORD=SdwCspIw2y0Wl5dj8wm063PQGHlIEarXukwPjknZ2BM=
# 初始化线程池数，最小空闲的线程数，最大创建的线程数 @Symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.initialSize=1
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.minIdle=5
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.maxActive=30
# 配置获取连接等待超时的时间, 单位ms @Symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.maxWait=30000
# 链接保持 缺省120s @symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.keepAlive=true
# 配置间隔多久才进行一次检测，检测需要关闭的空闲连接，单位是毫秒 @Symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.timeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis=10000
# 小空闲时间，单位毫秒，达到最小空闲时间，且当前这种连接超过minIdle,那么该部分连接会被关闭 @Symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.minEvictableIdleTimeMillis=600000
# 最大空闲时间，单位毫秒， 超过后，连接池中的连接会被关闭 @Symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.maxEvictableIdleTimeMillis=900000
# 通过sql查询，验证数据库连接是否有效 @Symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.validationQuery=SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
# 数据库连接池在空闲时是否进行连接有效性检测，为true表示启用检测，连接池取出后在使用前会进行有效性检查，为false表示不检查有效性，会使程序在
# 某些情况下拿到已经失效的连接 @Symon

# 从连接池中取连接是进行检查，如果为ture, 每次拿连接时都会测试该连接是否有效，如果测试失败，该连接将会丢弃，并且重新拿连接 @Symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.testOnBorrow=false
# 在连接归还连接池时是否进行检测，如果为true, 则每个链接返回连接池都会验证该连接是否有效，如果无效，它会从连接池中移除 @Symon

# 应用名称 @Symon
spring.application.name=urule

# ========================================================================
# ======== Module:datasource common config start ========
# ========================================================================
# 登录控制台的用户名和密码, 敏感信息，注意保密 @Symon
spring.datasource.druid.stat-view-servlet.loginUsername=prod
spring.datasource.druid.stat-view-servlet.loginPassword=prod
# ShardingDb config 20230116 add for sharding @Symon
spring.stardatasource.enable=true
# sharding control 分表控制开关 @Symon
core.database.sharding.bit=00
# init entity config list @Symon
spring.app.supported.entity.list=MXCC99990900,MXCC20220000,MXDC20220000
# 日志脱敏, log sensitive, 配置了后将会以**的格式进行打印 @Symon
logging.sensitive=trueName:last_four;cvv;pin;firstName;middleName;lastName;lastName2,phoneNo:pan;email;idValue;x-api-key;X-Api-Key
# sharding secrets aws.secrets.manager @Symon
aws.secrets.manager.region=us-east-1
aws.secrets.remote.name=CoreBankingFundcoreSecretProd
# stardatasource list
spring.stardatasource.names=corebankingShadow,corebankingA1,corebankingB1
# ========================================================================
# ======== Module:datasource common config end ========
# ========================================================================


# ========================================================================
# ======== Module:datasource corebankingA1 config start ========
# ========================================================================
# stori db, 数据库的连接地址、用户名和密码，敏感信息，请勿泄露 @Symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.name=corebankingA1
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.asyncInit=true
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.dataSourceClassName=com.alibaba.druid.pool.DruidDataSource
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.driverClassName=com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.url=jdbc:mysql://core-banking-middleware-r1.cluster-cutyhv5lxbqp.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com:3306/urule?useUnicode=true&characterEncoding=UTF-8
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.username=urule-2025
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.password=@PASSWORD=SdwCspIw2y0Wl5dj8wm063PQGHlIEarXukwPjknZ2BM=
# 初始化线程池数，最小空闲的线程数，最大创建的线程数 @Symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.initialSize= 1
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.minIdle= 5
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.maxActive= 30
# 配置获取连接等待超时的时间, 单位ms @Symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.maxWait= 30000
# 链接保持 缺省120s @symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.keepAlive=true
# 配置间隔多久才进行一次检测，检测需要关闭的空闲连接，单位是毫秒 @Symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.timeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis= 10000
# 小空闲时间，单位毫秒，达到最小空闲时间，且当前这种连接超过minIdle,那么该部分连接会被关闭 @Symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.minEvictableIdleTimeMillis= 600000
# 最大空闲时间，单位毫秒， 超过后，连接池中的连接会被关闭 @Symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.maxEvictableIdleTimeMillis= 900000
# 通过sql查询，验证数据库连接是否有效 @Symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.validationQuery= SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
# 数据库连接池在空闲时是否进行连接有效性检测，为true表示启用检测，连接池取出后在使用前会进行有效性检查，为false表示不检查有效性，会使程序在
# 某些情况下拿到已经失效的连接 @Symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.testWhileIdle= true
# 从连接池中取连接是进行检查，如果为ture, 每次拿连接时都会测试该连接是否有效，如果测试失败，该连接将会丢弃，并且重新拿连接 @Symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.testOnBorrow= false
# 在连接归还连接池时是否进行检测，如果为true, 则每个链接返回连接池都会验证该连接是否有效，如果无效，它会从连接池中移除 @Symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.testOnReturn= false

# 配置监控统计拦截的filters，去掉后监控界面sql无法统计，'wall'用于防火墙 @Symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.filters= stat,wall,slf4j
# 配置数据库连接池特定属性的配置项, 通过connectProperties属性来打开mergeSql功能；慢SQL记录 @Symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.connectionProperties= druid.stat.mergeSql=true;druid.stat.slowSqlMillis=3000;druid.stat.logSlowSql=true;druid.log.stmt.executableSql=true
# ========================================================================
# ======== Module:datasource corebankingA1 config end ========
# ========================================================================

# ========================================================================

spring.stardatasource.corebankingB1.username=urule-2025
spring.stardatasource.corebankingB1.password=@PASSWORD=SdwCspIw2y0Wl5dj8wm063PQGHlIEarXukwPjknZ2BM=

# 初始化大小，最小，最大

datasource.default.minIdle=5
datasource.default.maxActive=10
# 配置获取连接等待超时的时间

# 链接保持 缺省120s

datasource.default.testWhileIdle=true
datasource.default.testOnBorrow=false

# 下面为连接池的补充设置，应用到上面所有数据源中, 初始化线程池数，最小空闲的线程数，最大创建的线程数 @Symon
spring.datasource.shared.initialSize=5
spring.datasource.shared.minIdle=5
spring.datasource.shared.maxActive=10
# 配置获取连接等待超时的时间, 单位ms @symon

# 配置一个连接在池中最小生存的时间，单位是ms  @Symon

# 通过sql查询，验证数据库连接是否有效 @Symon
spring.datasource.shared.validationQuery=SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
# 数据库连接池在空闲时是否进行连接有效性检测，为true表示启用检测，连接池取出后在使用前会进行有效性检查，为false表示不检查有效性，会使程序在
# 某些情况下拿到已经失效的连接 @Symon
spring.datasource.shared.testWhileIdle=true
# 从连接池中取连接是进行检查，如果为ture, 每次拿连接时都会测试该连接是否有效，如果测试失败，该连接将会丢弃，并且重新拿连接 @Symon
spring.datasource.shared.testOnBorrow=false
# 在连接归还连接池时是否进行检测，如果为true, 则每个链接返回连接池都会验证该连接是否有效，如果无效，它会从连接池中移除 @Symon
spring.datasource.shared.testOnReturn=false
# 连接池是否启用预编译语句的缓存, 打开PSCache，并且指定每个连接上PSCache的大小 @Symon
spring.datasource.shared.poolPreparedStatements=true
# 设置每个数据库连接上允许缓存的最大预编译语句数量 @Symon
spring.datasource.shared.maxPoolPreparedStatementPerConnectionSize=20
# 配置监控统计拦截的filters，去掉后监控界面sql无法统计，'wall'用于防火墙 @Symon
spring.datasource.shared.filters=stat,wall,log4j
# 开启慢查询日志记录 @Symon
spring.datasource.shared.logSlowSql=true
# 配置数据库连接池特定属性的配置项, 通过connectProperties属性来打开mergeSql功能；慢SQL记录 @Symon

spring.stardatasource.corebankingShadow.maxActive=20
# 配置获取连接等待超时的时间, 单位ms @Symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingShadow.maxWait=6000
# 链接保持 缺省120s @symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingShadow.keepAlive=true
# 配置间隔多久才进行一次检测，检测需要关闭的空闲连接，单位是毫秒 @Symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingShadow.timeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis=2000
# 最小空闲时间，单位毫秒，达到最小空闲时间，且当前这种连接超过minIdle,那么该部分连接会被关闭  @Symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingShadow.minEvictableIdleTimeMillis=600000
# 最大空闲时间，单位毫秒， 超过后，连接池中的连接会被关闭 @symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingShadow.maxEvictableIdleTimeMillis=900000
# 通过sql查询，验证数据库连接是否有效 @Symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingShadow.validationQuery=SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
# 数据库连接池在空闲时是否进行连接有效性检测，为true表示启用检测，连接池取出后在使用前会进行有效性检查，为false表示不检查有效性，会使程序在
# 某些情况下拿到已经失效的连接 @Symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingShadow.testWhileIdle=true
# 连接池中取连接是进行检查，如果为ture, 每次拿连接时都会测试该连接是否有效，如果测试失败，该连接将会丢弃，并且重新拿连接 @Symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingShadow.testOnBorrow=false
# 在连接归还连接池时是否进行检测，如果为true, 则每个链接返回连接池都会验证该连接是否有效，如果无效，它会从连接池中移除 @Symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingShadow.testOnReturn=false

# 配置监控统计拦截的filters，去掉后监控界面sql无法统计，'wall'用于防火墙 @Symon

# 配置数据库连接池特定属性的配置项, 通过connectProperties属性来打开mergeSql功能；慢SQL记录 @Symon
spring.stardatasource.corebankingShadow.connectionProperties=druid.stat.mergeSql=true;druid.stat.slowSqlMillis=3000;druid.stat.logSlowSql=true;druid.log.stmt.executableSql=true

spring.datasource.backoffice.validationQuery=SELECT 1 FROM DUAL

spring.datasource.backoffice.testOnBorrow=false

spring.datasource.backoffice.testOnReturn=false

spring.datasource.backoffice.poolPreparedStatements=true

# default config
druid.conf.default.driverClassName=com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
druid.conf.default.dataSourceClassName=com.alibaba.druid.pool.DruidDataSource
druid.conf.default.asyncInit=false

# default config..初始化大小，最小，最大
druid.conf.default.initialSize=1
druid.conf.default.minIdle=1
druid.conf.default.maxActive=10

# default config..配置获取连接等待超时的时间
druid.conf.default.maxWait= 6000

# default config..链接保持 缺省120s
druid.conf.default.keepAlive=true

# default config..配置间隔多久才进行一次检测，检测需要关闭的空闲连接，单位是毫秒
druid.conf.default.timeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis= 1000
druid.conf.default.minEvictableIdleTimeMillis= 600000
druid.conf.default.maxEvictableIdleTimeMillis= 900000
druid.conf.default.validationQuery= SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
druid.conf.default.testWhileIdle= true
druid.conf.default.testOnBorrow= false
druid.conf.default.testOnReturn= false

# default config..配置监控统计拦截的filters，去掉后监控界面sql无法统计，'wall'用于防火墙
druid.conf.default.filters= stat,wall,slf4j
druid.conf.default.connectionProperties= druid.stat.mergeSql=true;druid.stat.slowSqlMillis=3000;druid.stat.logSlowSql=true;druid.log.stmt.executableSql=true

# query endBalance by accountDate.
debit.account.end.balance.sql=SELECT a.customer_id, SUM(b.end_term_balance) AS amount FROM corebankingb.offline_data_ods.ods_dc_det_account_dd a JOIN corebankingb.offline_data_ods.ods_dc_det_account_daily_log_dd b ON a.customer_id in (${customerIds}) and a.account_no = b.account_no and b.account_date = ${accountDate} GROUP BY a.customer_id
# query minEndBalance in specify interval. [startAccountDate, endAccountDate]
debit.account.min.end.balance.sql=SELECT customer_id AS customerId, MIN(total_balance) AS amount FROM(SELECT a.customer_id, b.account_date, SUM(b.end_term_balance) AS total_balance FROM corebankingb.offline_data_ods.ods_dc_det_account_dd a JOIN corebankingb.offline_data_ods.ods_dc_det_account_daily_log_dd b ON a.customer_id IN (${customerIds}) AND a.account_no = b.account_no AND b.account_date >= ${startAccountDate} AND b.account_date <= ${endAccountDate} WHERE a.account_no NOT IN (SELECT det.account_no FROM corebankingb.offline_data_ods.ods_ct_contract_info_dd ct JOIN corebankingb.offline_data_ods.ods_dc_det_account_dd det ON ct.contract_id = det.contract_id WHERE ct.product_code = 'SVL001' AND ct.customer_id IN (${customerIds}) AND det.account_no = a.account_no) GROUP BY a.customer_id, b.account_date ) AS daily_totals GROUP BY customer_id 
# query incrementEndBalance in specify interval. [startAccountDate, endAccountDate]
debit.account.increment.end.balance.sql=SELECT customer_id as customerId, SUM(CASE WHEN account_date = ${endAccountDate} THEN total_balance ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN account_date = ${startAccountDate} THEN total_balance ELSE 0 END) AS amount FROM ( SELECT a.customer_id, b.account_date, SUM(b.end_term_balance) AS total_balance FROM corebankingb.offline_data_ods.ods_dc_det_account_dd a JOIN corebankingb.offline_data_ods.ods_dc_det_account_daily_log_dd b ON a.customer_id in (${customerIds}) and a.account_no = b.account_no where b.account_date in (${startAccountDate},${endAccountDate}) GROUP BY  a.customer_id, b.account_date) AS daily_totals GROUP BY customer_id

# 数据库连接地址、数据库名，以及密码，以下均为敏感信息，注意保密 @Leo
spring.datasource.shared.url=jdbc:mysql://core-banking.cluster-cutyhv5lxbqp.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com:3306/corebankingB1?useSSL=false&useUnicode=true&allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&characterEncoding=utf8
spring.datasource.shared.username=corebankingB1
spring.datasource.shared.password=@PASSWORD=hT9C3KZCm905rmWWSPqglA==
spring.datasource.shared.driver=com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver

# 登录控制台的用户名和密码, 敏感信息，注意报名 @Leo
spring.datasource.shared.loginUsername=root
spring.datasource.shared.loginPassword=root

# 下面为连接池的补充设置，应用到上面所有数据源中, 初始化线程池数，最小空闲的线程数，最大创建的线程数 @Leo
spring.datasource.shared.initialSize=5
spring.datasource.shared.minIdle=5
spring.datasource.shared.maxActive=10

# 配置获取连接等待超时的时间，单位是毫秒 @Leo
spring.datasource.shared.maxWait=60000
# 配置间隔多久才进行一次检测，检测需要关闭的空闲连接，单位是毫秒 @Leo
spring.datasource.shared.timeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis=60000
# 配置一个连接在池中最小生存的时间，单位是毫秒 @Leo
spring.datasource.shared.minEvictableIdleTimeMillis=300000
# 通过sql查询，验证数据库连接是否有效 @Leo
spring.datasource.shared.validationQuery=SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
# 数据库连接池在空闲时是否进行连接有效性检测，为true表示启用检测，连接池取出后在使用前会进行有效性检查，为false表示不检查有效性，会使程序在某些情况下拿到已经失效的连接 @Leo
spring.datasource.shared.testWhileIdle=true
# 从连接池中取连接是进行检查，如果为ture, 每次拿连接时都会测试该连接是否有效，如果测试失败，该连接将会丢弃，并且重新拿连接 @Leo
spring.datasource.shared.testOnBorrow=false
# 在连接归还连接池时是否进行检测，如果为true, 则每个链接返回连接池都会验证该连接是否有效，如果无效，它会从连接池中移除 @Leo
spring.datasource.shared.testOnReturn=false
# 连接池是否启用预编译语句的缓存, 打开PSCache，并且指定每个连接上PSCache的大小 @Leo
spring.datasource.shared.poolPreparedStatements=true
# 设置每个数据库连接上允许缓存的最大预编译语句数量 @Leo
spring.datasource.shared.maxPoolPreparedStatementPerConnectionSize=20
# 配置监控统计拦截的filters，去掉后监控界面sql无法统计，'wall'用于防火墙 @Leo
spring.datasource.shared.filters=stat,wall,log4j
# 开启慢查询日志记录 @Leo
spring.datasource.shared.logSlowSql=true
# 配置数据库连接池特定属性的配置项, 通过connectProperties属性来打开mergeSql功能；慢SQL记录 @Leo
spring.datasource.shared.connectionProperties=druid.stat.mergeSql=true;druid.stat.slowSqlMillis=5000

# 风控触发后是否异步通知的开关。close表示同步 @frey

# 风控不调用urule，调用本地方法，其他：风控调用urule @frey

# 风控升级新模式开关，open: 新模式，other: 旧模式 @frey

# 风控时间窗特征计算开关，open: 开启，other: 关闭 @frey
risk.feature.time.window.switch=open
# 风控消息消费开关，open: 处理，other: 不处理 @frey
risk.feature.consumer.switch=open

risk.black.list.max.size=6000

# 风控特征记录是否保存开关 @Jack

# query minEndBalance in specify interval. [startAccountDate, endAccountDate]
debit.account.min.end.balance.sql=SELECT customer_id AS customerId, MIN(total_balance) AS amount FROM(SELECT a.customer_id, b.account_date, SUM(b.end_term_balance) AS total_balance FROM corebankingb.offline_data_ods.ods_dc_det_account_dd a JOIN corebankingb.offline_data_ods.ods_dc_det_account_daily_log_dd b ON a.customer_id IN (${customerIds}) AND a.account_no = b.account_no AND b.account_date >= ${startAccountDate} AND b.account_date <= ${endAccountDate} WHERE a.account_no NOT IN (SELECT det.account_no FROM corebankingb.offline_data_ods.ods_ct_contract_info_dd ct JOIN corebankingb.offline_data_ods.ods_dc_det_account_dd det ON ct.contract_id = det.contract_id WHERE ct.product_code = 'SVL001' AND ct.customer_id IN (${customerIds}) AND det.account_no = a.account_no) GROUP BY a.customer_id, b.account_date ) AS daily_totals GROUP BY customer_id 
# query incrementEndBalance in specify interval. [startAccountDate, endAccountDate]
debit.account.increment.end.balance.sql=SELECT customer_id as customerId, SUM(CASE WHEN account_date = ${endAccountDate} THEN total_balance ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN account_date = ${startAccountDate} THEN total_balance ELSE 0 END) AS amount FROM ( SELECT a.customer_id, b.account_date, SUM(b.end_term_balance) AS total_balance FROM corebankingb.offline_data_ods.ods_dc_det_account_dd a JOIN corebankingb.offline_data_ods.ods_dc_det_account_daily_log_dd b ON a.customer_id in (${customerIds}) and a.account_no = b.account_no where b.account_date in (${startAccountDate},${endAccountDate}) GROUP BY  a.customer_id, b.account_date) AS daily_totals GROUP BY customer_id

# query minEndBalance in specify interval. [startAccountDate, endAccountDate]
debit.account.min.end.balance.sql=SELECT customer_id AS customerId, MIN(total_balance) AS amount FROM(SELECT a.customer_id, b.account_date, SUM(b.end_term_balance) AS total_balance FROM corebankingb.offline_data_ods.ods_dc_det_account_dd a JOIN corebankingb.offline_data_ods.ods_dc_det_account_daily_log_dd b ON a.customer_id IN (${customerIds}) AND a.account_no = b.account_no AND b.account_date >= ${startAccountDate} AND b.account_date <= ${endAccountDate} WHERE a.account_no NOT IN (SELECT det.account_no FROM corebankingb.offline_data_ods.ods_ct_contract_info_dd ct JOIN corebankingb.offline_data_ods.ods_dc_det_account_dd det ON ct.contract_id = det.contract_id WHERE ct.product_code = 'SVL001' AND ct.customer_id IN (${customerIds}) AND det.account_no = a.account_no) GROUP BY a.customer_id, b.account_date ) AS daily_totals GROUP BY customer_id
# query incrementEndBalance in specify interval. [startAccountDate, endAccountDate]

# default config
druid.conf.default.driverClassName=com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
druid.conf.default.dataSourceClassName=com.alibaba.druid.pool.DruidDataSource
druid.conf.default.asyncInit=true

# default config..初始化大小，最小，最大
druid.conf.default.initialSize= 1
druid.conf.default.minIdle= 5
druid.conf.default.maxActive= 30

# default config..配置获取连接等待超时的时间
druid.conf.default.maxWait= 30000

# default config..链接保持 缺省120s
druid.conf.default.keepAlive=true

# default config..配置间隔多久才进行一次检测，检测需要关闭的空闲连接，单位是毫秒
druid.conf.default.timeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis= 10000
druid.conf.default.minEvictableIdleTimeMillis= 600000
druid.conf.default.maxEvictableIdleTimeMillis= 900000
druid.conf.default.validationQuery= SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
druid.conf.default.testWhileIdle= true
druid.conf.default.testOnBorrow= false
druid.conf.default.testOnReturn= false

# default config..配置监控统计拦截的filters，去掉后监控界面sql无法统计，'wall'用于防火墙
druid.conf.default.filters= stat,wall,slf4j
druid.conf.default.connectionProperties=druid.stat.mergeSql=true;druid.stat.slowSqlMillis=3000;druid.stat.logSlowSql=true;druid.log.stmt.executableSql=true

# 应用名称 @King
spring.application.name=marketing

# =============================================================================
# ======== Module:datasource shared config start ========
# =============================================================================
# 数据库连接地址、数据库名，以及密码，以下均为敏感信息，注意保密 @King
spring.datasource.shared.url=jdbc:mysql://core-banking.cluster-cutyhv5lxbqp.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com:3306/corebankingB1?useSSL=false&useUnicode=true&allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&characterEncoding=utf8
spring.datasource.shared.username=corebankingB1
spring.datasource.shared.password=@PASSWORD=hT9C3KZCm905rmWWSPqglA==
spring.datasource.shared.driver=com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
# 登录控制台的用户名和密码, 敏感信息，注意保密 @King
spring.datasource.shared.loginUsername=root
spring.datasource.shared.loginPassword=root

# 下面为连接池的补充设置，应用到上面所有数据源中, 初始化线程池数，最小空闲的线程数，最大创建的线程数 @King
spring.datasource.shared.initialSize=5
spring.datasource.shared.minIdle=5
spring.datasource.shared.maxActive=10
# 配置获取连接等待超时的时间, 单位ms @King
spring.datasource.shared.maxWait=60000
# 配置间隔多久才进行一次检测，检测需要关闭的空闲连接，单位是ms, @King
spring.datasource.shared.timeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis=60000
# 配置一个连接在池中最小生存的时间，单位是ms @King
spring.datasource.shared.minEvictableIdleTimeMillis=300000
# 通过sql查询，验证数据库连接是否有效 @King
spring.datasource.shared.validationQuery=SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
# 数据库连接池在空闲时是否进行连接有效性检测，为true表示启用检测，连接池取出后在使用前会进行有效性检查，为false表示不检查有效性，会使程序在
# 某些情况下拿到已经失效的连接 @King
spring.datasource.shared.testWhileIdle=true
# 从连接池中取连接是进行检查，如果为ture, 每次拿连接时都会测试该连接是否有效，如果测试失败，该连接将会丢弃，并且重新拿连接 @King
spring.datasource.shared.testOnBorrow=false
# 在连接归还连接池时是否进行检测，如果为true, 则每个链接返回连接池都会验证该连接是否有效，如果无效，它会从连接池中移除 @King
spring.datasource.shared.testOnReturn=false
# 连接池是否启用预编译语句的缓存, 打开PSCache，并且指定每个连接上PSCache的大小 @King
spring.datasource.shared.poolPreparedStatements=true
# 设置每个数据库连接上允许缓存的最大预编译语句数量 @King
spring.datasource.shared.maxPoolPreparedStatementPerConnectionSize=20
# 配置监控统计拦截的filters，去掉后监控界面sql无法统计，'wall'用于防火墙 @King
spring.datasource.shared.filters=stat,wall,log4j
# 开启慢查询日志记录 @King
spring.datasource.shared.logSlowSql=true
# 配置数据库连接池特定属性的配置项, 通过connectProperties属性来打开mergeSql功能；慢SQL记录 @King
spring.datasource.shared.connectionProperties=druid.stat.mergeSql=true;druid.stat.slowSqlMillis=5000

# ======== Module:datasource shared config end ========

# query minEndBalance in specify interval. [startAccountDate, endAccountDate]
debit.account.min.end.balance.sql=SELECT customer_id AS customerId, MIN(total_balance) AS amount FROM(SELECT a.customer_id, b.account_date, SUM(b.end_term_balance) AS total_balance FROM corebankingb.offline_data_ods.ods_dc_det_account_dd a JOIN corebankingb.offline_data_ods.ods_dc_det_account_daily_log_dd b ON a.customer_id IN (${customerIds}) AND a.account_no = b.account_no AND b.account_date >= ${startAccountDate} AND b.account_date <= ${endAccountDate} WHERE a.account_no NOT IN (SELECT det.account_no FROM corebankingb.offline_data_ods.ods_ct_contract_info_dd ct JOIN corebankingb.offline_data_ods.ods_dc_det_account_dd det ON ct.contract_id = det.contract_id WHERE ct.product_code = 'SVL001' AND ct.customer_id IN (${customerIds}) AND det.account_no = a.account_no) GROUP BY a.customer_id, b.account_date ) AS daily_totals GROUP BY customer_id
# query incrementEndBalance in specify interval. [startAccountDate, endAccountDate]
debit.account.increment.end.balance.sql=SELECT customer_id as customerId, SUM(CASE WHEN account_date = ${endAccountDate} THEN total_balance ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN account_date = ${startAccountDate} THEN total_balance ELSE 0 END) AS amount FROM ( SELECT a.customer_id, b.account_date, SUM(b.end_term_balance) AS total_balance FROM corebankingb.offline_data_ods.ods_dc_det_account_dd a JOIN corebankingb.offline_data_ods.ods_dc_det_account_daily_log_dd b ON a.customer_id in (${customerIds}) and a.account_no = b.account_no where b.account_date in (${startAccountDate},${endAccountDate}) GROUP BY  a.customer_id, b.account_date) AS daily_totals GROUP BY customer_id

name: stmt-datasource-config
value:
# 20230116 add new config
spring.datasource.druid.stat-view-servlet.loginUsername=dev
spring.datasource.druid.stat-view-servlet.loginPassword=dev

# stardatasource list
datasource.names=configShadow,configA1,configB1,stmtShadow00,stmtShadow01,stmtShadow02,stmtA00,stmtB00,stmtA01,stmtB01,stmtA02,stmtB02,stmtA03,stmtB03,stmtA04,stmtB04,stmtB05,stmtA05,stmtB06,stmtA06,stmtA07,stmtB07,stmtA08,stmtB08,stmtA09,stmtB09,stmtA10,stmtB10,stmtB11,stmtB12

# default config
druid.conf.default.driverClassName=com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
druid.conf.default.dataSourceClassName=com.alibaba.druid.pool.DruidDataSource
druid.conf.default.asyncInit=true

# default config..初始化大小，最小，最大
druid.conf.default.initialSize= 1
druid.conf.default.minIdle= 5
druid.conf.default.maxActive= 30

# default config..配置获取连接等待超时的时间
druid.conf.default.maxWait= 30000

# default config..链接保持 缺省120s
druid.conf.default.keepAlive=true

# default config..配置间隔多久才进行一次检测，检测需要关闭的空闲连接，单位是毫秒
druid.conf.default.timeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis= 10000
druid.conf.default.minEvictableIdleTimeMillis= 600000
druid.conf.default.maxEvictableIdleTimeMillis= 900000
druid.conf.default.validationQuery= SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
druid.conf.default.testWhileIdle= true
druid.conf.default.testOnBorrow= false
druid.conf.default.testOnReturn= false

# default config..配置监控统计拦截的filters，去掉后监控界面sql无法统计，'wall'用于防火墙
druid.conf.default.filters= stat,wall,slf4j
druid.conf.default.connectionProperties= druid.stat.mergeSql=true;druid.stat.slowSqlMillis=3000;druid.stat.logSlowSql=true;druid.log.stmt.executableSql=true

# default config
druid.conf.default.driverClassName=com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
druid.conf.default.dataSourceClassName=com.alibaba.druid.pool.DruidDataSource
druid.conf.default.asyncInit=true

# default config..初始化大小，最小，最大
druid.conf.default.initialSize= 1
druid.conf.default.minIdle= 5
druid.conf.default.maxActive= 30

# default config..配置获取连接等待超时的时间
druid.conf.default.maxWait= 30000

# default config..链接保持 缺省120s
druid.conf.default.keepAlive=true

# default config..配置间隔多久才进行一次检测，检测需要关闭的空闲连接，单位是毫秒
druid.conf.default.timeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis= 10000
druid.conf.default.minEvictableIdleTimeMillis= 600000
druid.conf.default.maxEvictableIdleTimeMillis= 900000
druid.conf.default.validationQuery= SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
druid.conf.default.testWhileIdle= true
druid.conf.default.testOnBorrow= false
druid.conf.default.testOnReturn= false

# default config..配置监控统计拦截的filters，去掉后监控界面sql无法统计，'wall'用于防火墙
druid.conf.default.filters= stat,wall,slf4j
druid.conf.default.connectionProperties= druid.stat.mergeSql=true;druid.stat.slowSqlMillis=3000;druid.stat.logSlowSql=true;druid.log.stmt.executableSql=true

name: trading-datasource-config
value:
# 控制台
spring.datasource.druid.stat-view-servlet.loginUsername=prod
spring.datasource.druid.stat-view-servlet.loginPassword=prod

# stardatasource list
datasource.names=configShadow,configA1,configB1,tradingShadow00,tradingShadow01,tradingShadow02,tradingA00,tradingA01,tradingA02,tradingA03,tradingA04,tradingA05,tradingA06,tradingA07,tradingA08,tradingA09,tradingA10,tradingB00,tradingB01,tradingB02,tradingB03,tradingB04,tradingB05,tradingB06,tradingB07,tradingB08,tradingB09,tradingB10,tradingB11,tradingB12

# default config
druid.conf.default.driverClassName=com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
druid.conf.default.dataSourceClassName=com.alibaba.druid.pool.DruidDataSource
druid.conf.default.asyncInit=false

# default config..初始化大小，最小，最大
druid.conf.default.initialSize=1
druid.conf.default.minIdle=1
druid.conf.default.maxActive= 20

# default config..配置获取连接等待超时的时间
druid.conf.default.maxWait= 6000

# default config..链接保持 缺省120s
druid.conf.default.keepAlive=true

# default config..配置间隔多久才进行一次检测，检测需要关闭的空闲连接，单位是毫秒
druid.conf.default.timeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis= 2000
druid.conf.default.minEvictableIdleTimeMillis= 600000
#druid.conf.default.maxEvictableIdleTimeMillis= 900000
druid.conf.default.validationQuery= SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
druid.conf.default.testWhileIdle= true
druid.conf.default.testOnBorrow= false
druid.conf.default.testOnReturn= false

# default config..配置监控统计拦截的filters，去掉后监控界面sql无法统计，'wall'用于防火墙
druid.conf.default.filters= stat,wall,slf4j
druid.conf.default.connectionProperties= druid.stat.mergeSql=true;druid.stat.slowSqlMillis=3000;druid.stat.logSlowSql=true;druid.log.stmt.executableSql=true

# default config
druid.conf.default.driverClassName=com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
druid.conf.default.dataSourceClassName=com.alibaba.druid.pool.DruidDataSource
druid.conf.default.asyncInit=false

# default config..初始化大小，最小，最大
druid.conf.default.initialSize=1
druid.conf.default.minIdle=1
druid.conf.default.maxActive=20

# default config..配置获取连接等待超时的时间
druid.conf.default.maxWait=6000

# default config..链接保持 缺省120s
druid.conf.default.keepAlive=true

# default config..配置间隔多久才进行一次检测，检测需要关闭的空闲连接，单位是毫秒
druid.conf.default.timeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis=2000
druid.conf.default.minEvictableIdleTimeMillis=600000
#druid.conf.default.maxEvictableIdleTimeMillis= 900000
druid.conf.default.validationQuery=SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
druid.conf.default.testWhileIdle=true
druid.conf.default.testOnBorrow=false
druid.conf.default.testOnReturn=false

# default config..配置监控统计拦截的filters，去掉后监控界面sql无法统计，'wall'用于防火墙
druid.conf.default.filters=stat,wall,slf4j
druid.conf.default.connectionProperties=druid.stat.mergeSql=true;druid.stat.slowSqlMillis=3000;druid.stat.logSlowSql=true;druid.log.stmt.executableSql=true

# default config
druid.conf.default.driverClassName=com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
druid.conf.default.dataSourceClassName=com.alibaba.druid.pool.DruidDataSource
druid.conf.default.asyncInit=false

# default config..初始化大小，最小，最大
druid.conf.default.initialSize=1
druid.conf.default.minIdle=1
druid.conf.default.maxActive=10

# default config..配置获取连接等待超时的时间
druid.conf.default.maxWait= 6000

# default config..链接保持 缺省120s
druid.conf.default.keepAlive=true

# default config..配置间隔多久才进行一次检测，检测需要关闭的空闲连接，单位是毫秒
druid.conf.default.timeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis= 1000
druid.conf.default.minEvictableIdleTimeMillis= 600000
druid.conf.default.maxEvictableIdleTimeMillis= 900000
druid.conf.default.validationQuery= SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
druid.conf.default.testWhileIdle= true
druid.conf.default.testOnBorrow= false
druid.conf.default.testOnReturn= false

# default config..配置监控统计拦截的filters，去掉后监控界面sql无法统计，'wall'用于防火墙
druid.conf.default.filters= stat,wall,slf4j
druid.conf.default.connectionProperties= druid.stat.mergeSql=true;druid.stat.slowSqlMillis=3000;druid.stat.logSlowSql=true;druid.log.stmt.executableSql=true

druid.conf.default.minIdle=1

druid.conf.default.maxWait= 6000

druid.conf.default.keepAlive=true

druid.conf.default.testOnReturn= false

# 控制台
spring.datasource.druid.stat-view-servlet.loginUsername=prod
spring.datasource.druid.stat-view-servlet.loginPassword=prod

# stardatasource list
datasource.names=configShadow,configA1,configB1,stmtShadow00,stmtShadow01,stmtShadow02,stmtA00,stmtA01,stmtA02,stmtA03,stmtA04,stmtA05,stmtA06,stmtA07,stmtA08,stmtA09,stmtA10,stmtB00,stmtB01,stmtB02,stmtB03,stmtB04,stmtB05,stmtB06,stmtB07,stmtB08,stmtB09,stmtB10,stmtB11,stmtB12

# default config
druid.conf.default.driverClassName=com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
druid.conf.default.dataSourceClassName=com.alibaba.druid.pool.DruidDataSource
druid.conf.default.asyncInit=false

# default config..初始化大小，最小，最大
druid.conf.default.initialSize= 5
druid.conf.default.minIdle= 5
druid.conf.default.maxActive= 20

# default config..配置获取连接等待超时的时间
druid.conf.default.maxWait= 6000

# default config..链接保持 缺省120s
druid.conf.default.keepAlive=true

# default config..配置间隔多久才进行一次检测，检测需要关闭的空闲连接，单位是毫秒
druid.conf.default.timeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis= 2000
druid.conf.default.minEvictableIdleTimeMillis= 600000
#druid.conf.default.maxEvictableIdleTimeMillis= 900000
druid.conf.default.validationQuery= SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
druid.conf.default.testWhileIdle= true
druid.conf.default.testOnBorrow= false
druid.conf.default.testOnReturn= false

# default config..配置监控统计拦截的filters，去掉后监控界面sql无法统计，'wall'用于防火墙
druid.conf.default.filters= stat,wall,slf4j
druid.conf.default.connectionProperties= druid.stat.mergeSql=true;druid.stat.slowSqlMillis=3000;druid.stat.logSlowSql=true;druid.log.stmt.executableSql=true

# default config
druid.conf.default.driverClassName=com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
druid.conf.default.dataSourceClassName=com.alibaba.druid.pool.DruidDataSource
druid.conf.default.asyncInit=false

# default config..初始化大小，最小，最大
druid.conf.default.initialSize=5
druid.conf.default.minIdle=5
druid.conf.default.maxActive=15

# default config..配置获取连接等待超时的时间
druid.conf.default.maxWait=6000

# default config..链接保持 缺省120s
druid.conf.default.keepAlive=true

# default config..配置间隔多久才进行一次检测，检测需要关闭的空闲连接，单位是毫秒
druid.conf.default.timeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis=2000
druid.conf.default.minEvictableIdleTimeMillis=600000
#druid.conf.default.maxEvictableIdleTimeMillis=900000
druid.conf.default.validationQuery=SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
druid.conf.default.testWhileIdle=true
druid.conf.default.testOnBorrow=false
druid.conf.default.testOnReturn=false

# default config..配置监控统计拦截的filters，去掉后监控界面sql无法统计，'wall'用于防火墙
druid.conf.default.filters= stat,wall,slf4j
druid.conf.default.connectionProperties= druid.stat.mergeSql=true;druid.stat.slowSqlMillis=3000;druid.stat.logSlowSql=true;druid.log.stmt.executableSql=true

# 老的spring数据库配置 deprecated @Daniel

spring.datasource.shared.password=@PASSWORD=hT9C3KZCm905rmWWSPqglA==
spring.datasource.shared.driver=com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
#控制台
spring.datasource.shared.loginUsername=root
spring.datasource.shared.loginPassword=root

# 下面为连接池的补充设置，应用到上面所有数据源中
# 初始化大小，最小，最大
spring.datasource.shared.initialSize=5
spring.datasource.shared.minIdle=5
spring.datasource.shared.maxActive=10
# 配置获取连接等待超时的时间
spring.datasource.shared.maxWait=60000
# 配置间隔多久才进行一次检测，检测需要关闭的空闲连接，单位是毫秒
spring.datasource.shared.timeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis=60000
# 配置一个连接在池中最小生存的时间，单位是毫秒
spring.datasource.shared.minEvictableIdleTimeMillis=300000
spring.datasource.shared.validationQuery=SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
spring.datasource.shared.testWhileIdle=true
spring.datasource.shared.testOnBorrow=false
spring.datasource.shared.testOnReturn=false
# 打开PSCache，并且指定每个连接上PSCache的大小
spring.datasource.shared.poolPreparedStatements=true
spring.datasource.shared.maxPoolPreparedStatementPerConnectionSize=20
# 配置监控统计拦截的filters，去掉后监控界面sql无法统计，'wall'用于防火墙
spring.datasource.shared.filters=stat,wall,log4j
spring.datasource.shared.logSlowSql=true
# 通过connectProperties属性来打开mergeSql功能；慢SQL记录
spring.datasource.shared.connectionProperties=druid.stat.mergeSql=true;druid.stat.slowSqlMillis=5000

druid.conf.default.asyncInit=true

# default config..初始化大小，最小，最大
druid.conf.default.initialSize= 1
druid.conf.default.minIdle= 5
druid.conf.default.maxActive= 30

# default config..配置获取连接等待超时的时间
druid.conf.default.maxWait= 30000

# default config..链接保持 缺省120s
druid.conf.default.keepAlive=true

# default config..配置间隔多久才进行一次检测，检测需要关闭的空闲连接，单位是毫秒
druid.conf.default.timeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis= 10000
druid.conf.default.minEvictableIdleTimeMillis= 600000
druid.conf.default.maxEvictableIdleTimeMillis= 900000
druid.conf.default.validationQuery= SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
druid.conf.default.testWhileIdle= true
druid.conf.default.testOnBorrow= false
druid.conf.default.testOnReturn= false

# default config..配置监控统计拦截的filters，去掉后监控界面sql无法统计，'wall'用于防火墙
druid.conf.default.filters= stat,wall,slf4j
druid.conf.default.connectionProperties= druid.stat.mergeSql=true;druid.stat.slowSqlMillis=3000;druid.stat.logSlowSql=true;druid.log.stmt.executableSql=true

# 默认参数
datasource.default.driverClassName=com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
#控制台
datasource.default.loginUsername=root
datasource.default.loginPassword=root

# 下面为连接池的补充设置，应用到上面所有数据源中
# 初始化大小，最小，最大
datasource.default.initialSize=5
datasource.default.minIdle=5
datasource.default.maxActive=10
# 配置获取连接等待超时的时间
datasource.default.maxWait=60000
# 配置间隔多久才进行一次检测，检测需要关闭的空闲连接，单位是毫秒
datasource.default.timeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis=60000
# 配置一个连接在池中最小生存的时间，单位是毫秒
datasource.default.minEvictableIdleTimeMillis=300000
datasource.default.validationQuery=SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
datasource.default.testWhileIdle=true
datasource.default.testOnBorrow=false
datasource.default.testOnReturn=false
# 打开PSCache，并且指定每个连接上PSCache的大小
datasource.default.poolPreparedStatements=true
datasource.default.maxPoolPreparedStatementPerConnectionSize=20
# 配置监控统计拦截的filters，去掉后监控界面sql无法统计，'wall'用于防火墙
#datasource.default.filters=stat,wall,log4j
datasource.default.logSlowSql=true
# 通过connectProperties属性来打开mergeSql功能；慢SQL记录
datasource.default.connectionProperties=druid.stat.mergeSql=true;druid.stat.slowSqlMillis=5000

# default config
druid.conf.default.driverClassName=com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
druid.conf.default.dataSourceClassName=com.alibaba.druid.pool.DruidDataSource
druid.conf.default.asyncInit=true

# default config..初始化大小，最小，最大
druid.conf.default.initialSize= 1
druid.conf.default.minIdle= 5
druid.conf.default.maxActive= 10

# default config..配置获取连接等待超时的时间
druid.conf.default.maxWait= 30000

# default config..链接保持 缺省120s
druid.conf.default.keepAlive=true

# default config..配置间隔多久才进行一次检测，检测需要关闭的空闲连接，单位是毫秒
druid.conf.default.timeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis= 10000
druid.conf.default.minEvictableIdleTimeMillis= 600000
druid.conf.default.maxEvictableIdleTimeMillis= 900000
druid.conf.default.validationQuery= SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
druid.conf.default.testWhileIdle= true
druid.conf.default.testOnBorrow= false
druid.conf.default.testOnReturn= false

# default config..配置监控统计拦截的filters，去掉后监控界面sql无法统计，'wall'用于防火墙
druid.conf.default.filters= stat,wall,slf4j
druid.conf.default.connectionProperties= druid.stat.mergeSql=true;druid.stat.slowSqlMillis=3000;druid.stat.logSlowSql=true;druid.log.stmt.executableSql=true

spring.application.name=fundinsight

# 20230116 add new config
spring.datasource.druid.stat-view-servlet.loginUsername=dev
spring.datasource.druid.stat-view-servlet.loginPassword=dev
# ShardingDb config 20230116 add for sharding 
spring.stardatasource.enable=true
#  add for sharding
core.database.sharding.bit=00
#  init entity config list
spring.app.supported.entity.list=MXCC99990900,MXCC20220000,MXDC20220000
#  log sensitive
logging.sensitive=trueName:last_four;cvv;pin;firstName;middleName;lastName;lastName2,phoneNo:pan;email;idValue;x-api-key;X-Api-Key
#  sharding  secrets aws.secrets.manager
aws.secrets.manager.region=us-west-2
aws.secrets.remote.name=CoreBankingFundcoreSecretDev
# stardatasource list
spring.stardatasource.names=corebankingShadow,corebankingA1,corebankingB1
# stori db 
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.name=corebankingA1
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.asyncInit=true
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.dataSourceClassName=com.alibaba.druid.pool.DruidDataSource
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.driverClassName=com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.url= jdbc:mysql://mysql-stable.storicarddev.com:3306/corebankingA1?useSSL=false&useUnicode=true&allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&characterEncoding=utf8
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.username=corebankingA1-dev
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.password=@PASSWORD=2okauL4529I/TMXDD6r5OMuCX+T85MVp/KYkXOHlJB4=
# 初始化大小，最小，最大
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.initialSize= 1
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.minIdle= 5
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.maxActive= 30
# 配置获取连接等待超时的时间
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.maxWait= 30000
# 链接保持 缺省120s
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.keepAlive=true
# 配置间隔多久才进行一次检测，检测需要关闭的空闲连接，单位是毫秒
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.timeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis= 10000
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.minEvictableIdleTimeMillis= 600000
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.maxEvictableIdleTimeMillis= 900000
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.validationQuery= SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.testWhileIdle= true
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.testOnBorrow= false
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.testOnReturn= false

# 配置监控统计拦截的filters，去掉后监控界面sql无法统计，'wall'用于防火墙
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.filters= stat,wall,slf4j
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.connectionProperties= druid.stat.mergeSql=true;druid.stat.slowSqlMillis=3000;druid.stat.logSlowSql=true;druid.log.stmt.executableSql=true

# 默认参数
datasource.default.driverClassName=com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
#控制台
datasource.default.loginUsername=root
datasource.default.loginPassword=root

# 下面为连接池的补充设置，应用到上面所有数据源中
# 初始化大小，最小，最大
datasource.default.initialSize=5
datasource.default.minIdle=5
datasource.default.maxActive=10
# 配置获取连接等待超时的时间
datasource.default.maxWait=60000
# 配置间隔多久才进行一次检测，检测需要关闭的空闲连接，单位是毫秒
datasource.default.timeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis=60000
# 配置一个连接在池中最小生存的时间，单位是毫秒
datasource.default.minEvictableIdleTimeMillis=300000
datasource.default.validationQuery=SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
datasource.default.testWhileIdle=true
datasource.default.testOnBorrow=false

spring.application.name=gateway
spring.datasource.gateway.url=jdbc:mysql://mysql.storicarddev.com:3306/gatewayA1?useSSL=false&useUnicode=true&allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&characterEncoding=utf8
spring.datasource.gateway.username=gatewayA1-dev
spring.datasource.gateway.password=@PASSWORD=V2jYwGoXR5hJeHQiPc4J1suCX+T85MVp/KYkXOHlJB4=
spring.datasource.gateway.driverClassName=com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
#控制台
spring.datasource.gateway.loginUsername=root
spring.datasource.gateway.loginPassword=root

# 下面为连接池的补充设置，应用到上面所有数据源中
# 初始化大小，最小，最大
spring.datasource.gateway.initialSize=5
spring.datasource.gateway.minIdle=5
spring.datasource.gateway.maxActive=10
# 配置获取连接等待超时的时间
spring.datasource.gateway.maxWait=60000
# 配置间隔多久才进行一次检测，检测需要关闭的空闲连接，单位是毫秒
spring.datasource.gateway.timeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis=60000
# 配置一个连接在池中最小生存的时间，单位是毫秒
spring.datasource.gateway.minEvictableIdleTimeMillis=300000
spring.datasource.gateway.validationQuery=SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
spring.datasource.gateway.testWhileIdle=true
spring.datasource.gateway.testOnBorrow=false
spring.datasource.gateway.testOnReturn=false
# 打开PSCache，并且指定每个连接上PSCache的大小
spring.datasource.gateway.poolPreparedStatements=true
spring.datasource.gateway.maxPoolPreparedStatementPerConnectionSize=20
# 配置监控统计拦截的filters，去掉后监控界面sql无法统计，'wall'用于防火墙
#spring.datasource.gateway.filters=stat,wall,log4j
spring.datasource.gateway.logSlowSql=true
# 通过connectProperties属性来打开mergeSql功能；慢SQL记录
spring.datasource.gateway.connectionProperties=druid.stat.mergeSql=true;druid.stat.slowSqlMillis=5000
# aws secret manager
aws.secrets.manager.region=us-west-2

# retry error codes
retry.error.codes=ST012COBSFDCC399
retry.switch=open

# 加密配置
stori.pgp.open=true
stori.pgp.config[0].tenantId=STMXFINCORE0
stori.pgp.config[0].entityId=MXCC20220000
stori.pgp.config[0].privateKey=CoreBankingGatewayPomeloEncryptSecretDev|encrypt-stori-pomelo-privatekey
stori.pgp.config[0].password=@PASSWORD=UnSwOxybG8dnNvwlG/HwJysC/QShg/4owbF3dOcN1//RlfrXTWpObXBZQ99BOBzORCLyfctuxgvMpstv2nL9wC+OIayoJlM7otC7V0DjppA=
stori.pgp.config[0].publicKey=CoreBankingGatewayPomeloEncryptSecretDev|encrypt-pomelo-stori-publickey

# 默认参数
datasource.default.driverClassName=com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
#控制台
datasource.default.loginUsername=root
datasource.default.loginPassword=root

# 下面为连接池的补充设置，应用到上面所有数据源中
# 初始化大小，最小，最大
datasource.default.initialSize=5
datasource.default.minIdle=5
datasource.default.maxActive=10
# 配置获取连接等待超时的时间
datasource.default.maxWait=60000
# 配置间隔多久才进行一次检测，检测需要关闭的空闲连接，单位是毫秒

# 配置一个连接在池中最小生存的时间，单位是毫秒
datasource.default.minEvictableIdleTimeMillis=300000
datasource.default.validationQuery=SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
datasource.default.testWhileIdle=true
datasource.default.testOnBorrow=false
datasource.default.testOnReturn=false
# 打开PSCache，并且指定每个连接上PSCache的大小
datasource.default.poolPreparedStatements=true
datasource.default.maxPoolPreparedStatementPerConnectionSize=20
# 配置监控统计拦截的filters，去掉后监控界面sql无法统计，'wall'用于防火墙

# 应用名称 @daryl
spring.application.name=trading

# ==========================================================================
# ======== Module:datasource shared config start ========
# ==========================================================================
# 数据库连接地址、数据库名，以及密码，以下均为敏感信息，注意保密 @daryl
spring.datasource.shared.url=jdbc:mysql://core-banking.cluster-cutyhv5lxbqp.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com:3306/corebankingB1?useSSL=false&useUnicode=true&allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&characterEncoding=utf8
spring.datasource.shared.username=corebankingB1
spring.datasource.shared.password=@PASSWORD=hT9C3KZCm905rmWWSPqglA==
spring.datasource.shared.driver=com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver

# 登录控制台的用户名和密码, 敏感信息，注意保密 @daryl
spring.datasource.shared.loginUsername=root
spring.datasource.shared.loginPassword=root

# 下面为连接池的补充设置，应用到上面所有数据源中
# 初始化线程池数，最小空闲的线程数，最大创建的线程数 @daryl
spring.datasource.shared.initialSize=5
spring.datasource.shared.minIdle=5
spring.datasource.shared.maxActive=10
# 配置获取连接等待超时的时间, 单位ms @daryl
spring.datasource.shared.maxWait=60000
# 配置间隔多久才进行一次检测，检测需要关闭的空闲连接，单位是毫秒 @daryl
spring.datasource.shared.timeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis=60000
# 配置一个连接在池中最小生存的时间，单位是毫秒 @daryl
spring.datasource.shared.minEvictableIdleTimeMillis=300000
# 通过sql查询，验证数据库连接是否有效 @daryl
spring.datasource.shared.validationQuery=SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
# 数据库连接池在空闲时是否进行连接有效性检测，为true表示启用检测，连接池取出后在使用前会进行有效性检查，为false表示不检查有效性，会使程序在
# 某些情况下拿到已经失效的连接 @daryl
spring.datasource.shared.testWhileIdle=true
# 从连接池中取连接是进行检查，如果为ture, 每次拿连接时都会测试该连接是否有效，如果测试失败，该连接将会丢弃，并且重新拿连接 @daryl
spring.datasource.shared.testOnBorrow=false
# 在连接归还连接池时是否进行检测，如果为true, 则每个链接返回连接池都会验证该连接是否有效，如果无效，它会从连接池中移除 @daryl
spring.datasource.shared.testOnReturn=false
# 连接池是否启用预编译语句的缓存, 打开PSCache，并且指定每个连接上PSCache的大小 @daryl
spring.datasource.shared.poolPreparedStatements=true
# 设置每个数据库连接上允许缓存的最大预编译语句数量 @daryl
spring.datasource.shared.maxPoolPreparedStatementPerConnectionSize=20
# 配置监控统计拦截的filters，去掉后监控界面sql无法统计，'wall'用于防火墙 @daryl
spring.datasource.shared.filters=stat,wall,log4j
# 开启慢查询日志记录 @daryl

spring.application.name=fundinsight

# start 20230116 新增配置
spring.datasource.druid.stat-view-servlet.loginUsername=dev
spring.datasource.druid.stat-view-servlet.loginPassword=dev

#  sharding control 分表控制开关
core.database.sharding.bit=00
#  init entity config list
spring.app.supported.entity.list=MXCC99990900,MXCC20220000,MXDC20220000
#  log sensitive
logging.sensitive=trueName:last_four;cvv;pin;firstName;middleName;lastName;lastName2,phoneNo:pan;email;idValue;x-api-key;X-Api-Key
#  sharding  secrets aws.secrets.manager
aws.secrets.manager.region= us-east-1
aws.secrets.remote.name= CoreBankingFundcoreSecretQa
# stardatasource list
spring.stardatasource.names=corebankingA1,corebankingB1,corebankingShadow
# stori db
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.name=corebankingA1
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.asyncInit=false
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.dataSourceClassName=com.alibaba.druid.pool.DruidDataSource
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.driverClassName=com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.url= jdbc:mysql://core-banking-mysql-qa.cluster-cpuztzrlf1ji.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com:3306/corebankingA1?useSSL=false&useUnicode=true&allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&characterEncoding=utf8
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.username=corebankingA1-qa
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.password=@PASSWORD=y9UL01QCKpGaFwvP8GOMucuCX+T85MVp/KYkXOHlJB4=
# 初始化大小，最小，最大
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.initialSize= 5
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.minIdle= 10
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.maxActive= 20
# 配置获取连接等待超时的时间
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.maxWait= 6000
# 链接保持 缺省120s
spring.stardatasource.corebankingA1.keepAlive=true
